-- Migrar cat5 → cat9 para MASCOTE e MORUMBI (recorrência agora é cat9)
UPDATE faturamentos 
SET cat9 = cat5, cat5 = '0'
WHERE empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE', 'MORUMBI') 
  AND (cat5 IS NOT NULL AND cat5 != '0' AND cat5 != '');

-- Verificar resultado
SELECT empresaSlug, SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat9, SUM(CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat5
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE', 'MORUMBI') AND mes = 3 AND ano = 2026
GROUP BY empresaSlug;
